The '''Mah Dala Infirmary''' was a local disease center on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gobindi]]. This location served for one of the parts of the [[Project Starscream]] at the hands of [[Borborygmus Gog]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]] traveled to the planet Gobindi and stopped on the Infirmary for moments.
